name: ipaddr.js
why: MIT-licensed pure JavaScript with over a decade of history, regression-tested address-handling fixes and small source enhancements, runnable offline without native code or a browser, and moderate visibility.

name: rrule
why: BSD-3-Clause-licensed JavaScript/TypeScript recurrence logic with over a decade of history, numerous regression-tested calendar fixes and source features, offline tests and no native or browser requirement.

name: sift
why: MIT-licensed MongoDB-style matching logic with over a decade of history, small operator fixes accompanied by tests and source-level enhancements, no database or network requirement, and moderate visibility.

name: color-convert
why: MIT-licensed pure JavaScript color mathematics with over a decade of history, tested conversion corrections and small source enhancements, offline Node tests and less prominent individual fixes.

name: base-x
why: MIT-licensed JavaScript encoding logic with more than five years of history, regression-tested encoding fixes and small implementation changes, no native or network dependency, and moderate visibility.

name: uri-js
why: BSD-2-Clause-licensed JavaScript URI logic with over a decade of history, regression-tested standards edge-case fixes and source enhancements, offline tests and relatively low commit-level prominence.

name: jsbi
why: Apache-2.0-licensed pure JavaScript integer arithmetic dating to 2018, with regression-tested arithmetic fixes and source improvements, tests runnable in Node without native code or network access, and moderate visibility.

name: fraction.js
why: MIT-licensed pure JavaScript rational arithmetic with over a decade of history, many regression-tested edge-case fixes and small source features, offline tests and lower prominence than general-purpose numeric libraries.
